remarks: AMONG THE BEST LOCATIONS IN THE TONAWANDAS! *FANTASTIC INVESTMENT* Step into the charm and character of nostalgia at 209 Goundry St in the heart of North Tonawanda minutes away from all the best amenities: Historic Riviera Theatre, all season family entertainment venues, art galleries, restaurants, shopping, historic landmarks, boating, bike trails, etc. Whether you're searching for a permanent residence, seasonal retreat, vacation rental, or investment opportunity, this distinctive home offers all that.  Generously sized rooms, rich hardwood floors, beautiful vintage-stained glass, original wood trim, and a gorgeous classic tile bathroom floor. Important updates have already been completed, including newer windows and furnace (2022) and water heater (2026). With an easy layout flow, this home is ready for someone with a savvy vision. Much potential on the third floor: den, studio, getaway room. Newly added back entrance overlooks a spacious backyard. Showings begin immediately. Open House: 9/26, Saturday, 11-1pm
